statement: The site's media has one copy, in one AWS account and region: S3 versioning covers a deletion or an overwrite, not a compromised account, an account closure or a regional loss.

treatment.plan: Approved by the owner on 2026-11-18 21:29 BRT (a copy in a second AWS region, under US$ 1 a month). S3 Cross-Region Replication of the media bucket to tower-media-replica-<account>-us-west-2 (infra/aws/stacks/58-media-replica.json, region in infra/aws/regions.json): versioned, SSE-S3, private, retained, noncurrent versions 90 days; the media stack's rule (ReplicaRegion in parameters.json) copies every new object version as Glacier Instant Retrieval and never replicates a delete marker, so a deletion or an overwrite in us-east-1 leaves the copy whole. The objects older than the rule are copied once by an S3 Batch Replication job (the runbook's 'A cópia da mídia em outra região'). About US$ 0.03 a month, about US$ 1 once. It covers a regional loss and a deletion in the primary, not a compromised account or its closure (same account, no Object Lock). Verified on 2026-11-18 22:39 BRT (the Torre): the merge deploy of #249 (tower-infra-deploy:86218c47) created tower-app-media-replica in us-west-2 and the rule media-replica (Enabled, GLACIER_IR, delete markers off); Batch Replication job fac31b6a-ab70-4b87-840f-355f25d0c8e9 completed 31,093 of 31,093 tasks with 0 failures; both buckets list 31,028 objects and 3,388,226,582 bytes. What remains is the residual risk a compromised or closed account carries, which only a separate account or Object Lock would treat.

source: docs/programs/padrao-dev/fornecimento-cloudflare.md (the R2 deletion, 18/11; 'A cópia da mídia em outra região', 19/11)
